verdict.summary: The allowlist additions correctly classify the reactive flow-on engine and rule table as orchestration-only while preserving normal crate narrowing for mixed changes. The existing inertness test covers both new entries against the enumerated Rust-CI workflows, and flow-on-gates independently runs the engine's focused test suite without a ci-select guard. The new classification tests exercise both the all-orchestration and mixed-change paths and pass alongside the inertness checks.
